description.en: The unique ID of the live stream resource.

description.zh: 用户UserId，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符。
description.en: The user ID, which must be unique within the AppId. The ID can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). The maximum length is 32 characters.
